title: Nice Lantern, But Lights Don't Show Up Well
text: Nice Lantern, But Lights Don't Show Up Well. The lantern is actually really cute. The sugar skull punch out design looks nice. The finish on the lantern is even and well done. There's a little light at the bottom of the inside, but it doesn't produce enough light to show the punch out design well at all, even in total darkness. You can see the chin area of the skull, but not the top half, so the effect is pretty much lost. I've been playing around with different alternative lights to get a better lit image, but it's a little difficult because the interior bottom is not flat. I've had the most luck with a string of battery operated fairy lights. I think this would be a 4 or 5 star item with better light. A bonus would be if it included a timer feature (runs for 5 hours) or something like that on the light.
